posts.summary: Survey claim about cross-system navigation risk.
posts.draft: Rowan Trollope, the 69% perception signal raises a useful measurement question: what failure counts as inability to navigate? Missing a system, using stale state and crossing an unauthorised boundary need different controls. A benchmark that reports those separately would help teams avoid improving connectivity at the expense of access discipline.

posts.summary: Iris combines context retrieval, memory, integration, caching and search.
posts.draft: Rowan Trollope, joining these context components makes invalidation a system-level requirement. A corrected CRM fact may need to expire a retrieved record, a semantic-cache response and a durable memory entry together. Time until all three stop returning the old fact would be a useful control metric alongside retrieval latency and token savings.
